label: Diagram 3.5
caption: Diagram 3.5 Floor type 1.2B – external
description: The image is a section drawing headed "Diagram 3.5 Floor type 1.2B – external cavity wall with masonry inner leaf", with the word "SECTION" printed in the lower right corner. On the left, a vertical external cavity wall is shown in cross-section, made up of an outer leaf of horizontal rectangular blocks and an inner cross-hatched masonry leaf separated by an open cavity; the label "External cavity wall" appears beneath it. A horizontal floor build-up projects to the right from the wall. A small block sitting in the cavity at floor level is indicated by a leader line labelled "Cavity stop". The floor comprises several stacked horizontal layers, including a top dotted layer, a middle band of small circles, and a lower layer with a zigzag (sawtooth) pattern and a small diagonally hatched triangle at its left end, which a single leader line identifies as "Timber batten". A horizontal double-headed dimension arrow set to the right of the inner leaf is labelled "Minimum 300mm", running from the face of the inner masonry leaf to a vertical tick line near the right-hand end of the floor layers.
